think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value (e.g., -1, 0) is documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/unlimited) rather than just being a smaller/larger quantity. 3) If such a mode-switch value exists, classify as a special knob and record that value; otherwise classify as not special.
